messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alice Holden <alice@infracorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VPC/On-Prem Deployment Initiation — Routing & Provisioning Responsibilities

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the time earlier — this thread is to kick off the VPC/on-prem intake for the Redwood deployment and to confirm ownership for the first set of networking and provisioning items. Attached is our initial checklist and a CSV of account-level specs to speed intake.

High level asks from our side (please confirm which InfraCorp team owns each):
- Egress IPs and NAT/GW design (static allocations vs. NAT pool)
- Peering/BGP termination point and who will configure BGP sessions
- Route propagation / custom route tables (who owns route table entries)
- Service account provisioning + IAM role scoped for inference nodes
- Ports and L4 allowlist for telemetry (we usually need 443, 53 for DNS, and a set of ephemeral ports)
- KMS/HSM key policy and who will rotate keys
- Maintenance windows and planned downtime windows for the first 90 days

Proposed next steps:
1) InfraCorp confirms owners for the bullets above and returns the requested contact(s) (NetOps, Cloud Platform).
2) We schedule a 60-minute handoff meeting (proposed Wed 2025-05-07 10:00 PT).
3) Redwood raises infra tickets for service account + peering once ownership is confirmed.

Please see attachments: Redwood_Infracorp_Initial-Checklist.pdf (checklist) and Account_Specs.csv (CIDR preferences, region, projected throughput).

If you prefer, loop in Bob from MediaCorp who will be our on-prem integrator for the edge site.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Director, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Infracorp_Initial-Checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: Account_Specs.csv (text/csv)]

From: Alice Holden <alice@infracorp.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: InfraCorp Network Team <netops@infracorp.com>, Bob Yang <bob.yang@mediacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 05 May 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VPC/On-Prem Deployment Initiation — Routing & Provisioning Responsibilities

Hi Lauren,

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and owners below — I'll follow up with the NetOps ticket and attach the current infra diagram.

- Egress/NAT: NetOps (netops@infracorp.com) will provide a static NAT pool; they'll confirm exact IPs by EOD Tue.
- BGP termination: Edge routing team (cc'd under NetOps) will own BGP session. We prefer BFD + EBGP for failover.
- Route tables: Cloud Platform will accept route injections for the Redwood subnets; route propagation will be handled by them.
- Service accounts/IAM: Security group (sec-identity@infracorp.com) will create restricted service principals — we need the minimum role list from Redwood.
- Ports: NetOps confirmed 443 inbound for API, TCP 9200-9300 for internal telemetry (we can tighten if you provide a CIDR list).
- KMS: Security will provision a customer-controlled CMK; key policy review is required.
- Maintenance windows: Prefer weekend UTC SUNDAY 02:00-06:00 for initial cutover; NetOps will confirm blackout windows.

Attachments: infra-diagram-v1.png (high-level). I created NETOPS ticket NETOPS-492 to track BGP + peering details.

We can do the handoff Wed 05/07 10:00 PT — that works for me.

Best,
Alice
Senior Cloud Program Manager
InfraCorp
[Attachment: infra-diagram-v1.png (image/png)]

- Peering & BGP session verification: InfraCorp NetOps (owner) + Redwood Ben for handshake and config validation.
- Route table entries: InfraCorp Cloud Platform (owner); Redwood will supply target prefixes.

- KMS policy review: Olga Petrov (redwood security lead) to sync with sec-identity@infracorp.com for key policy template.
- Telemetry egress (S3/metrics): Priyom Das (redwood infra) will provide endpoints and retry semantics.

Mutual action plan (short):
1) Redwood sends minimal IAM role list + CIDR matrix (by EOD Tue 2025-05-06).
2) InfraCorp confirms NAT IP range + BGP details (NETOPS-492).
3) Joint handoff meeting Wed 2025-05-07 10:00 PT — meeting invite incoming.
4) After handoff, Redwood opens INFRA tickets for provisioning (we'll reference NETOPS-492 and create INFRA-8421 for peering verification).

Attachments: I put together a one-page responsibilities table and included the checklist again. Also linking the DocuSign SOW so Legal can get signatures before provisioning starts: DocuSign: 0b9f2a6c-sow

Hi all,

Adding a few technical clarifications ahead of today's handoff:
- Ports: we'll share a tight CIDR-to-port matrix by the meeting (expect a 3-line CSV: service,ports,cidrs). For initial validation, allow TCP 443 and TCP 9000-9100 between Redwood inference subnets and your telemetry collectors.
- CIDR requests: We'll request /27 blocks for the worker pools (to support autoscaling). If InfraCorp prefers different sizing we can adapt.
- INFRA tickets: I created INFRA-8421 in our tracker to track peering verification and will link NETOPS-492.

I'll join the 10am handoff — forwarding calendar invite to NetOps.
